newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mostly lower on hedge sales.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mostly lower on hedge sales.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mostly lower on hedge selling but scale-down commercial buying limited losses, traders said.
"We had some pretty decent scale-down buying today despite the fact that we were kind of the weak sister to Chicago all day," one trader said.

Volume was light early but picked up in late dealings. Traders said Wilson Trading bought 1.8 million March while LFG Futures bought 500,000 March and sold one million March in late dealings. Benson Quinn bought 600,000 March and sold at least one million, traders said.
News Pakistan will tender in January for 270,000 tonnes U.S. or Australian wheat was seen as supportive.
But wheat was pressured by ideas farmer selling will pick up at the first of the year. Some farmers had been holding on to wheat to defer tax payments.

Also, rail car receipts were higher than expected as elevators rushed to move grain to balance books before the end of the year. Traders noted railroad tracks reopened on Monday after snow and ice made them impassable last week.
Wheat closed 4 cents per bushel lower to 2 cents higher with March down 3-1/2 at $3.77-3/4. Barley did not trade.
The exchange will be closed Wednesday in observance of the New Year's Day holiday.
